output.sql: SELECT order_month, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month
output.explanation: Monthly revenue for 2025 is the net revenue of completed orders (is_revenue), excluding shipping fees. It is grouped by order month and listed in calendar order, in EUR.
